title: Vanilla RTP Queue
description: Simple and lightweight highly customizable RTP Queue plugin.
body:
# Vanilla RTP Queue
Vanilla RTP Queue is a simple and lightweight plugin that allows your players to run a command, which will start matchmaking, then teleport the two to the same location. 

# Setup

1. Download the plugin
2. Add your plugin to your plugins folder
3. Start or restart your server
4. Customize your plugin by going to your plugins folder > VanillaRTPQueue (Folder) > config.yml
5. Use /rtpqueue to matchmake
6. You're all set! Happy dueling.
